id: # The 能力表 of the Power Up Kit (pk-officer-training.md, manual p.30, p.31). One row for each ability that research can open.

# kind: plus (the ability rises by amount), floor (an ability below amount rises to amount), aptitude (the class rises to the grade amount: 1 B, 2 A, from the grade before only), skill (target is the skill number; an existing skill is replaced).
# count: the uses that one research gives (documented 1, 3 or 5). months: the length of the research (documented 3 to 6). requires: the rows before it on the arrows, | between rows.
# The costs and the arrows that the manual names are documented; the chart itself is not in the spec, so the rows and counts are assumed (Q-040, Q-188).
